answer: Before any payout is released, an agent must present a signed attestation from one verifiable device, bound to a single public key — a pass earned by crossing the ridge to checked identity. Independent auditors verify that signature against the public registry within 24 hours; a missing or mismatched attestation blocks payment, and a duplicate burns the deposit and revokes the key. An honest operator needs one device, while a thousand fakes need a thousand attestations, turning an oasis of identities into a sable trail of forfeited deposits.
